components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: var(--ds-radius-control, 0.5rem); background: var(--ds-color-accent, #2563eb); color: var(--ds-color-accent-foreground, #ffffff); padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; font: 600 0.875rem/1.2 var(--ds-font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ds-color-accent-dark, #1d4ed8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ds-color-accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Elevated Card
components.html:
Component title

Concise supporting copy for an editorial interface surface.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--ds-color-border, #d4d4d4); border-radius: var(--ds-radius-card, 0.5rem); background: var(--ds-color-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ds-color-text, #171717); padding: 1rem; box-shadow: var(--ds-shadow-card, 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05)); font-family: var(--ds-font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 700; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--ds-color-text-muted, #404040); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Field Input
components.description: Neutral text input with accessible focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; color: var(--ds-color-text, #171717); font-family: var(--ds-font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-field span { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-field input { min-height: 2.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--ds-color-border, #d4d4d4); border-radius: var(--ds-radius-control, 0.5rem); background: var(--ds-color-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ds-color-text, #171717); padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ds-color-accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Soft Pill
components.css: .ds-pill-soft { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; border-radius: var(--ds-radius-pill, 0.125rem); background: var(--ds-color-accent-subtle, #eff6ff); color: var(--ds-color-accent-dark, #1d4ed8); padding: 0.125rem 0.625rem; font: 600 0.75rem/1.4 var(--ds-font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Editorial navigation item with active blue state.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.25rem; font-family: var(--ds-font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-nav a { color: var(--ds-color-text, #171717); padding: 0.5rem 0.25rem; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--ds-color-accent, #2563eb); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ds-color-accent, #2563eb); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Gaudi is a curated design system for reading and working on the web. It brings the blog and application interfaces together through clear hierarchy, compact controls, neutral surfaces, and blue accents that signal action, selection, and wayfinding.

Components and patterns can come from many sources; their integration should feel coherent. Extend existing owners, use shared foundations, and support practical use cases across articles, forms, data views, navigation, and complete workflows. Preserve comfortable reading alongside efficient task completion.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral reading and working surfaces with blue used as a functional accent.
Compact geometry, visible focus, and restrained elevation.
Separate root, MDX, and runtime entrypoints to keep interfaces lean.
Dark mode is intentionally composed, not mechanically inverted.

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue is functional, not decorative. Spend it on action, selection, focus, links, and data emphasis before using it for atmosphere.

rules.name: The Single Voice Rule
rules.body: Use one sans family for interface and editorial UI. Bring in mono only for code, data, or keyboard notation.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: Prefer border and tonal separation at rest. Add shadow when a surface is floating, modal, or actively interactive.

dos: Do use Gaudi tokens, variants, icons, and exported components before creating a local one-off.
Do preserve the root, MDX, and runtime entrypoint separation.
Do keep keyboard focus, dialog focus trapping, alt text, and reduced-motion behavior intact.
Do use blue to clarify interaction and current state.
donts: Don't import consuming app data, generated content, or route-specific files into Gaudi.
Don't copy components into consuming applications when an exported Gaudi primitive exists.
Don't use color as the only status cue.
Don't add large decorative shadows, glass effects, or oversized radii to routine reading and application surfaces.
